name: Devi of the Six
bio: Encased with Devi's Phantasmic Arms are the souls of six departed Magi, all dedicated the art of pugilomancy. Magic that can only be harnessed by punching REALLY hard. Devi proved herself as the newest holder of the Phantasmic Arms by punching its last holder through a mountain. Don't challenge her to an arm wrestle.
